title: Crystal Clear icons
lede: Everaldo Coelho’s glossy, translucent desktop icons: saturated color, bright highlights, and soft shading.
summary: Glossy, gel-like 3D icons in saturated colors. Everaldo Coelho for KDE and Linux desktops.

evidence.note: Inspected the 128 × 128 LGPL icon [File:Crystal Clear kdmconfig-danger.png](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crystal_Clear_kdmconfig-danger.png) and stored it.

styles.note: Wikipedia uses this icon to illustrate the style’s vibrant colors, three-dimensional graphics, and glossy textures.

context: Coelho’s “crystal” look “consists of icons that appear to be made of highly reflective surfaces.” He aimed “between realism of Mac OS X and cartoon colored style of XP.” Crystal SVG became KDE’s default icon theme in KDE 3.1; the later Crystal Clear set made icons appear transparent. [Wikipedia: Everaldo Coelho](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Everaldo_Coelho).

The Wikipedia Frutiger Aero article illustrates “vibrant colors, three-dimensional graphics, and glossy textures” with this icon, and lists Crystal icons under “See also.” [Wikipedia: Frutiger Aero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frutiger_Aero).
observed: Three rounded, faceless figures in saturated green, blue, and red look like molded gel.
Each figure has a bright white specular highlight on the head and shoulder and darker shading at the edges.
A yellow warning triangle with an exclamation mark overlaps the front, with a soft shadow.
interpretation: Crystal predates Vista, but it already has the style’s icon grammar: candy color, gel volume, and a single hard highlight. It helped make gloss the default look of free desktops.
borrow: Draw icons as simple rounded volumes with one strong white highlight and a darker rim, rather than outlines.

images.alt: Glossy icon of three rounded human figures in green, blue, and red with white highlights, and a yellow warning triangle with an exclamation mark.
